integrity: Finite enumeration and cellular boundary matrices are reproduced by checker.py; the homotopy conclusion uses explicit equivariant collapses and CW generator cancellations. No independent third-party audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The quotient statement concerns only the Fano cap complex with its Singer order-seven subgroup. No extension to all finite projective planes or to the full collineation group is asserted; unindexed equivalent literature and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: A seven-torsion Moore quotient of the Fano cap complex
